text: I have now been trying to get through for nearly an hour. My grandson is 8 months. His temperature is 39.9, I have taken it twice to be sure. One of his eyes is pink and sticky, I've been wiping it with cooled boiled water but it keeps gunking up again. He also has a sore red nappy rash, I think it's from all the changing, I've been putting cream on. I'm not sure whether the temperature that high means he should be seen tonight or if I can wait for the GP. I would like an answer please.
